summary: Completed testing RnD Approval History & Detail View features. Backend APIs fully functional (55/55 tests passed). One minor issue: DA-PL03-RND appears in second row (test style in first row due to date sorting). Regression testing: Roll Kain menu found in Portal Gudang.
